decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-60daa9bc529f] saying failing e2e ApplicationSet tests for ksonnet applications were resolved, with a pointer to PR #21580. It does not say what was changed: only test code, or product code (such as ApplicationSet or ksonnet handling) to make the tests pass. Without that, no product subject can be named, and it is unclear whether any environment is exposed. The PR diff or a list of changed files would show whether this is a test-only change with no applicability.
